Hi Alice - great questions, thanks for pulling these together. Per your request, summary below and attaching a short RTBF process doc + retention diagram. I looped in Dev (ops/legal) for the precise timelines and backup constraints.

Quick answers (summary):
- End-to-end purge timeline (hosted API logs): we remove account-scoped request logs and associated prompt/output artifacts within 30 days from a validated RTBF request.
- Backups: backups are on a 30/90 day rotation depending on storage tier. Deletion from snapshot backups is subject to the backup lifecycle - in practice, we mark data for deletion immediately and it is purged at next snapshot rewrite; for most customers this results in full removal within 90 days.
- PII handling: we support both deletion and field-level redaction. For realtime request logs we can run a purge that removes personal identifiers; aggregated telemetry is retained in pseudonymized form by default.
- Residency & segmentation: by default FintechCo data is stored in the US region (us-west); EU residency is available as a deployment option. Backups are stored in region-aligned buckets when EU residency is required.
- Escalations: Dev will list the legal ops contact for subpoenas.

Next steps:
1) Dev to confirm exact backup window and any constraints for immutable backups (Dev: can you confirm if any archived/offline tapes exist?)
2) If FintechCo requires a shorter purge SLA we can evaluate a dedicated retention policy and Dedicated/Private deployment options.
3) I'll prepare a short one-pager you can share with your DPO - attaching now.

Hi all - adding more detail from infra/ops:
- "Validated RTBF request": needs an authenticated request via the account admin console or signed DPA request from an authorized FintechCo contact (we can ingest via API or manual ticketing).
- Primary logs: request/response logs (text bodies) are retained in a hot store for 30 days and tombstoned on delete; they are then fully removed from the hot store on the next garbage-collection cycle (<=30 days).
- Snapshot/backups: incremental snapshots are kept for up to 90 days for standard customers. For customers on our standard hosted tier we do not have offline tapes - all snapshots are object-store based. For customers requiring >90 day retention for compliance we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments where they control the snapshot policy.
- Backups & geo: when EU residency is selected, all storage and snapshots are pinned to eu-west buckets; cross-region replication is opt-in.
- Edge cases: backups stored in long-term archival (cold) are only used for disaster recovery and are purged on our normal schedule; if a customer requires guaranteed immediate removal from every historical snapshot we advise Private deployment with customer-managed key deletion to ensure crypto-irreversible deletion.
